title: 第238章 南境之王第237章 初代勇者的大宝藏
slug: 我在西幻世界独断万古
content_zh:
第238章南境之王
海雀号的帆刚吃满风，天色便骤然暗了下来。
远处的云层以肉眼可见的速度翻涌堆积，铅灰色的云底压得极低，仿佛整片天空都在缓缓沉降。
一道银白色的闪电从云层中劈落，将海面照得惨白，紧接着便是沉闷的雷声。
“这雨来得够急的。”
伊芙琳船长收紧舵绳，朝桅杆上的水手喊了一嗓子，“收半帆！把前三角帆也收了，别让风把桅杆掀了！”
水手们应声而动，绳索在滑轮间飞速滑动，帆面被迅速收拢。
海雀号的船身在海浪中起伏了几下，随即恢复平稳。
莉莉丝蹲在船尾的避风处，正把钓鱼用的细绳往木箱里收，忽地抬头望向铃兰岛的方向。
“师傅！那边……山腰上好像有蛇！好大好粗的蛇！”
季天顺着她手指的方向望去。
铃兰岛的山腰处，在闪电劈落的间歇，几道粗壮的、蜿蜒的蛇形轮廓隐现于山体表面，身体呈灰黑色，与山体的颜色几乎融为一体。
它们在雷光闪烁间若隐若现，姿态僵硬，没有任何蠕动的迹象。
是遗骸。
季天的目光落在在那几道轮廓上，终于明白信中那句“吞云吐雾的动物朋友们”指的是什么了。
海上、能吞云吐雾、形似巨蛇的生物，那不就是“海市蜃楼”中的蜃吗？
那这一切都说得通了。
季天本以为那些生物早已离开了，现在想来，那几具横亘在山腰的巨蛇遗骸或许就是它们最后的归宿。
换言之，初代勇者口中的“动物朋友”已经不复存在。
他收回目光。

“走吧，暴雨要来了。”
海雀号重新沿着来时航线向狮牙城方向驶去。
身后的铃兰岛在雨幕中逐渐模糊，那座岛屿在雷光中显现又消散，最终只剩暗灰色轮廓线横亘于苍茫海天之间。
……
狮牙城，治安所大厅。
教会驻岛主教维拉尔坐在长桌一端，面前摊着十几份羊皮纸档案。
对面坐着一个穿着深灰色短外套、戴着半旧皮手套的中年男人，约莫五十岁上下，面容瘦削，颧骨高耸，浅褐色眼眸在不甚明亮的光线里显得格外冷静。
他叫卡尔琴科，教会的传奇调查员，被圣城派到狮牙城快两个月了。
他的任务很明确：查清那些新式火炮究竟是从哪座作坊流出来的，以及背后到底是谁在为海盗供货。
这两个月里他换了三次身份，从码头工人到酒馆常客再到修船铺的学徒，把狮牙城的地下网络摸了个大概。
他早就锁定了其中几位关键人物，包括中间人、铸炮作坊的打杂工、负责运输的船主，但真正能指向源头的那条线一直没能连上。
直到昨天，他收到了圣殿骑士团在南境海域巡逻时截获的情报：
一艘从狮牙城出发、挂着商船旗号的小型货船在航向中偏离了预定航线，被巡逻队登船检查后查获了船舱里未登记的火炮部件。
那条船的船主已经被押回狮牙城，关在治安所的地下牢房里。
“招了？”卡尔琴科询问道。
维拉尔主教将一份口供记录推过来。
“他在船上藏了封没来得及销毁的信，收信地址是狮牙城东区一座仓库，我们的人已经盯住了那个仓库，里面的人和你所调查出的结果完全一致。”
卡尔琴科将口供记录折好收入衣袋：“今晚动手，再拖下去他们会换地方。”
……
雨下到后半夜时渐渐小了，转为持续不断的细雨。

狮牙城东区的街道在雨幕中几乎空无一人，沿途的店铺早早关上了门板。
第238章南境之王
卡尔琴科站在街角的阴影里，身后是十二名圣殿骑士团调来的精锐战士。

Chapter 238 King of the South
As soon as the Puffin's sails were full of wind, the sky suddenly darkened.
The clouds in the distance surged and piled up at a speed visible to the naked eye, and the lead-gray cloud base was extremely low, as if the entire sky was slowly sinking.
A bolt of silver-white lightning split from the clouds, illuminating the sea palely, followed by a dull thunder.
"This rain is coming fast enough."
Captain Evelyn tightened the rudder rope and shouted to the sailor on the mast, "Reef half the sail! Retract the jib too, don't let the wind lift the mast!"
The sailors moved in response, the ropes slid rapidly between the pulleys, and the sails were quickly furled.
The Puffin's hull heaved a few times in the waves, then returned to stability.
Lilith was squatting in the shelter of the stern of the boat, putting the fishing rope into the wooden box, when she suddenly raised her head and looked in the direction of Lily of the Valley Island.
"Master! Over there... there seems to be a snake on the mountainside! Such a big and thick snake!"
Ji Tian looked in the direction of her finger.
On the mountainside of Suzuland Island, during the pauses between lightning strikes, several thick, winding snake-shaped outlines loomed on the surface of the mountain. Their bodies were gray-black, almost blending in with the color of the mountain.
They were looming in the flashes of lightning, their postures were stiff, and there was no sign of any movement.
It's the remains.
Ji Tian's eyes fell on those outlines, and he finally understood what the phrase "animal friends who smoke and smoke" in the letter referred to.
Aren't the creatures on the sea that can swallow clouds and spit out mist and look like giant snakes the mirage in "mirage"?
Then it all makes sense.
Ji Tian originally thought that those creatures had left long ago, but now that he thought about it, those remains of the giant snakes lying on the mountainside might be their final destination.
In other words, the "animal friends" mentioned by the first generation of heroes no longer exist.
He looked away.
"Let's go, a heavy rain is coming."
The Puffin sailed towards Lion's Tooth City along its original route again.
The Lily of the Valley Island behind him gradually blurred in the rain. The island appeared and disappeared in the thunder. In the end, only a dark gray outline was left across the vast sea and sky.
…
Lion's Tooth City, the lobby of the police station.
Villar, the church's resident bishop on the island, sat at one end of the long table with a dozen parchment files spread out in front of him.
Sitting across from him was a middle-aged man wearing a dark gray short coat and half-used leather gloves. He was about fifty years old. He had a thin face, high cheekbones, and light brown eyes that looked particularly calm in the dim light.
His name is Karchenko, the legendary investigator of the church. He has been sent to Lion's Tooth City by the Holy City for almost two months.
His mission was clear: to find out which workshop those new artillery pieces came from, and who was supplying the pirates behind the scenes.
In the past two months, he had changed his identity three times, from a dock worker to a tavern regular to an apprentice at a ship repair shop, and he had a rough idea of ​​the underground network of Lion Tooth City.
He had already identified several of the key figures, including the middleman, the handyman in the cannon-making workshop, and the ship owner responsible for transportation, but he had never been able to connect the line that could really point to the source.
Until yesterday, he received intelligence intercepted by the Knights Templar while patrolling the southern waters:
A small cargo ship sailing from Lion Tooth City and flying the merchant ship's flag deviated from the planned route. After being boarded and inspected by the patrol, unregistered artillery parts were found in the cabin.
The owner of that boat has been escorted back to Lion Tooth City and locked up in the underground cell of the Public Security Bureau.
"Recruited?" Kalchenko asked.
Bishop Villar pushed over a transcript of the confession.
"He hid a letter on the ship that he didn't have time to destroy. The recipient's address is a warehouse in the east area of Lion's Tooth City. Our people have already focused on that warehouse, and the people inside are exactly the same as what you found out."
Karchenko folded the confession record and put it in his pocket: "Let's start tonight. If it continues, they will change places."
…
The rain gradually subsided in the second half of the night and became continuous.Intermittent drizzle.
The streets in the east district of Lion Tooth City were almost deserted amid the rain, and the shops along the way had closed their doors early.
Chapter 238 King of the South
Karchenko stood in the shadows on the street corner, behind him were twelve elite soldiers transferred from the Knights Templar.
